title: Deep Learning-Based Evaluation of Ultrasound Images for Benign Skin Tumors.
summary: This retrospective, single-center diagnostic study uses a residual-plus-attention CNN to classify three histopathology-confirmed benign skin tumors from 698 ultrasound images. The source reports patient-grouped five-fold evaluation, 95.87% mean accuracy, 90.10% sensitivity and 96.23% specificity, with class-activation-map comparison to physician findings. The result is limited to this cohort and needs external validation.
